qualification_summary: Initial qualification: enterprise finance platform with strict residency and audit needs. Workloads: low-latency chat (p95 target <120ms for 1k reqs/min), bulk embeddings for search (daily batches), and reranking. High cost-sensitivity on per-token; exploring reserved Dedicated vs Private. Model preference: open models (Llama2, Mistral) with quantized variants; require canary/fallback to smaller models for capacity spikes.
architecture_fit: Preferred deployment: Redwood Private provisioned into customer VPC. Topology notes: control-plane connectivity via PrivateLink (no public ingress to inference nodes); inference nodes in private subnets across multiple AZs (us-west-2 primary, eu-west-1 secondary). Outbound: restricted egress via NAT Gateway or egress VPC endpoints; allowlist only to Redwood control plane endpoints and model repo IPs for model updates. Data flow: customer S3 via VPC endpoint; audit logs streamed to customer CloudWatch and mirrored to S3 for retention. KMS: customer-owned AWS KMS must support cross-account grants; Redwood will use customer key ARN; HSM integration flagged as later phase. Network: require VPC endpoints for S3, ECR (if used), Secrets Manager; optional interface endpoints for PrivateLink. Ports: mostly TLS (443) for control plane; gRPC/HTTP for intra-VPC orchestration. Compliance: design satisfies SOC2/ISO27001 controls pending review; legal needs DPA/residency text.
